title: Figure 19: Experiments To Prove a Plasma Fusion Propulsion Concept
description: Composite figure centered on a cutaway schematic of a field-reversed configuration (FRC) plasma ring with labels for H beam, conducting wall, rotating plasma, external current, reaction products, 3He/4He ions, magnetic field (FRC), plasma current and B beam. Corner insets show 'HTS Technology' (photo of superconductor hardware), 'Energy Recovery' (alpha particle graphic), 'Physical Modeling' (color simulation) and 'Plasma Physics' (plasma image), each with explanatory text, e.g. 'High Temperature Superconductor research needs to be scaled up and made to withstand the fusion environment'.
